_about: Acetic acid (1) + Cyclohexane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetic acid, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetic acid, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Z. Yang, J. Zhu, B. Wu, K. Chen, X. Ye, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for (Acetic Acid + Cyclohexane) and (Cyclohexane + Acetylacetone) at a Pressure of 101.3 kPa and for (Acetic Acid + Acetylacetone) at a Pressure of 60.0 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 55 (2010) 1527-1531
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 12, 13. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0118 (fails, >= 0.01; taken by decision of the maintainer, see docs/decisions/2026-11-13-04-acetic-acid-cyclohexane.md). To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
